_note: The paid tier and its modules. Read by WConvert\Support\TierManifest in free's tree, and by bin/verify-artifact-contract.sh when it proves the Pro ZIP carries every module it names. Free ships this file; Pro does not, because free is always present beside it (Pro's min-core guard refuses to boot without it) and two copies is two things to drift. See docs/adr/0146-pro-is-one-tier.md.

free.description: Lead capture for WordPress — popups and inline forms, created goal-first.

premium._modules_note: A module is a DIRECTORY under pro/modules/, holding its own module.json. Everything under that directory is the module and nothing outside it is, which is what lets the artifact contract check a module by checking a directory.
premium._no_wildcard_note: Pro NAMES its modules — there is no "*". A wildcard reads as "everything", which is true of what the build should contain and useless to a check: bin/verify-artifact-contract.sh asserts the Pro ZIP carries every module named here, and against "*" that asserts nothing. The cost is that a new module must be added to this list, and that cost is paid loudly: a Pro ZIP carrying a module this list does not name fails the contract before the ZIP is written.
premium._tiers_note: One paid tier. The product is free plus one Pro with every feature; the Nexus plans (single-site, 5-sites, unlimited) differ only in how many sites they cover, so a plan is not a tier (ADR 0146, superseding ADR 0056's three-rung ladder). WConvert\Support\Tier spells the same list in code, and TierManifestTest keeps the two in step. Every `tier:` value in resources/rules/manifest.json, resources/templates/locked.json and the design libraries is a slug from WConvert\Support\Tier — TierSlugsAreRealTest fails on any that is not, because an unknown slug reads as free.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.description: Everything: fullscreen campaigns, floating bars, slide-ins, automatic inline placement, journeys, the premium Triggers and Conditions, A/B testing, cart recovery and the outbound Destinations.
tiers._destinations_note: The services Pro's destinations module connects to, by brand name. Free cannot ask the registry — Pro's types are not registered without Pro — so its Destinations hint reads them here (ADR 0147). TierManifestTest keeps this in step with the label() of every DestinationType in pro/modules/destinations/src.
